titulo: Intuit layoffs 2024: about $1.678M paid out per job cut
caption:
Intuit layoffs 2024: about $1.678M paid out per job cut

Intuit layoffs 2024: the CEO email said "Today is an incredibly difficult day." The same company's 10-K shows $3.02 billion paid to shareholders that fiscal year.
From the archive: Jul 2024. Not today's news.

What happened: on Jul 10, 2024, Intuit's CEO, Sasan Goodarzi, emailed employees (filed with the SEC in an 8-K). The email says about 1,800 employees, 10% of the workforce, will be leaving. It also says Intuit will hire about 1,800 new people.

What a buyback is: a company spends cash to buy its own shares back from the market. A dividend is cash paid to shareholders. Both count as money returned to shareholders.

The numbers, in Intuit's own 10-K: $1,988 million of stock repurchased plus $1,034 million of dividends in fiscal 2024 (the year that ended July 31, 2024), company-wide, for $3.02 billion paid to shareholders.
The math: $3.02 billion in buybacks and dividends (2024) ÷ about 1,800 job cuts = about $1.678 million in buybacks and dividends per job cut. This divides two company-wide figures; it does not say one caused the other.

Incredibly difficult day. Here is the shareholder column. (Our take.)

Send this to someone who has been through a round of cuts.

Synthetic voice. Sources: Intuit 8-K, CEO email (SEC), Jul 10, 2024; Intuit 10-K, fiscal 2024 (SEC), Sep 4, 2024.
